mapper.select:
SELECT FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_parent_student parent_student ON parent_student.student_id = student.id AND parent_student.parent_user_id = #{userId} AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE' AND parent_student.relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND parent_student.primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY'
WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED'
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT FROM edu_student student
WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization scoped_relation JOIN sys_organization scoped_organization ON scoped_organization.id = scoped_relation.organization_id WHERE scoped_relation.student_id = student.id AND scoped_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_admin organization_admin JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON administrator_root.id = organization_admin.organization_id WHERE organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} AND scoped_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') ) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization filter_organization WHERE filter_organization.id = #{organizationId} AND ( (filter_organization.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization class_relation WHERE class_relation.student_id = student.id AND class_relation.organization_id = filter_organization.id AND class_relation.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND class_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' )) OR (filter_organization.organization_type <> 'CLASS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization filter_relation JOIN sys_organization relation_organization ON relation_organization.id = filter_relation.organization_id WHERE filter_relation.student_id = student.id AND filter_relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(filter_organization.organization_path, '%') )) ) )
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT FROM edu_student student
JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.teacher_user_id = #{userId} AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = current_class.organization_id AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED'
AND current_class.organization_id = #{organizationId}
AND student.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY student.student_name, student.id

SELECT DISTINCT teacher.id AS user_id, teacher.display_name, teacher_class.class_organization_id FROM sys_user teacher LEFT JOIN edu_teacher_class teacher_class ON teacher_class.teacher_user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_class.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization teacher_class_organization JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON teacher_class_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = administrator_root.id WHERE teacher_class_organization.id = teacher_class.class_organization_id AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} ) WHERE teacher.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role teacher_role_assignment JOIN sys_role teacher_role ON teacher_role.id = teacher_role_assignment.role_id WHERE teacher_role_assignment.user_id = teacher.id AND teacher_role.role_code = 'TEACHER' AND teacher_role.status = 'ENABLED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization teacher_membership JOIN sys_organization teacher_organization ON teacher_organization.id = teacher_membership.organization_id JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON teacher_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = administrator_root.id WHERE teacher_membership.user_id = teacher.id AND organization_admin.user_id = #{userId} )
AND teacher_class.class_organization_id = #{classId}
AND teacher.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY teacher.display_name, teacher.id, teacher_class.class_organization_id
